GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 383.6 (23 Sep 46) GB/CIS
(SCAPIN - 1226)
APO 500
23 September 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Release of WACHI, Tsunezo.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum for the Imperial Japanese Government, AG 383.6 (25 April 46) CIS, Subject: "Incarceration of WACHI, Tsunezo at Sugamo Prison".
2. The Imperial Japanese Government is hereby informed that WACHI, Tsunezo has been ordered released from Sugamo Prison.
3. The Imperial Japanese Government is directed to assume custody of subject individual on or before 1200 hours, 4 October 1946, at Sugamo Prison. Failure to assume custody at stated time will result in unconditional release of the prisoner.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
